title: SEMEVIA: fine-grained vehicle recognition with an Identity Evidence Passport
description: SEMEVIA detects a vehicle with YOLO11n, identifies its make, model and year among the 196 Stanford Cars categories with classical, deep (fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0) and hybrid heads, and reports an Identity Evidence Passport: a conformally calibrated candidate set summarised at the most specific level the evidence supports, with a six-region Evidence Challenge. Built for the Computer Vision Hackathon 2026 (problem statement PS5) by team Hypermetropia. Evaluation results are generated from saved reports (eval_P5_T35.md). Code: AGPL-3.0. Trained model files (GitHub Releases model-v1 to model-v3): CC BY-NC 4.0, see LICENSE-MODELS.md.
